patterns.scope: author B, E, F, G, H (and A)
items: all items of authors B, E, F, G, H
patterns.evidence: Key in slot A: B 16/18, F 15/18, G 16/18, H 17/18; key in slot D: E 22/22. Author A never puts the key in A (0/22). Batch: A 73, B 20, C 19, D 40 of 152. 7 of the 8 non-A keys in B/F/G/H are not-except items keyed D (B-P2A-3, B-P3A-2, F-P2A-4, F-P3B-5, G-P3A-3, G-P3B-2; plus F-P1A-1 B, H-P3A-1 B); not-except in B/E/F/G is keyed D 8/8. Only a tell if choices are served in stored order; if the renderer shuffles, this disappears, but the file as written is unshuffled for five of eight authors.

patterns.property: key is in the pair of options sharing the longest opening (>=3 words, pair not all four)
patterns.evidence: 10/10 (chance ~50%). G-P2A-4 key 'how the writer missed out on a part in the play and came to value painting the scenery' twins 'how the writer missed out on a part in the play and decided to give up acting for good'; A-P3B-2 key 'A family agrees to leave a wasp nest alone, and a boy's fear turns into interest' twins '...alone, and the wasps move away'; A-P3A-1 key 'A study found that the woodpecker's head acts as a stiff hammer...' twins 'A study found that the woodpecker's skull absorbs shock...'. Rule: pick from the twin pair, then choose the positive arc (next pattern). Across all kinds 22/28; purpose 5/9 and detail 5/7 are mixed.

patterns.property: option with a failure/negative ending is never the key; key is the positive-resolution or learning arc
patterns.evidence: Hand-coded: in 7 items where one option ends in failure/quitting/damage and another in success, the failure option is the key 0/7. 'decided to give up acting for good' (G-P2A-4), 'how damage to the collection ended it' / 'a minister's protest kept working people out' (G-P3A-5), 'why the writer quit the team' (B-P2A-4), 'why the old man refused to pay him' (C-P2A-3), 'how a winter storm broke it' (C-P3A-5), 'broke the tablet' / 'could not hear' (F-P2A-1). Keys: 'view ... changed', 'came to value', 'reshaped the collection', 'proved its worth', 'taught Tova to test rocks'. A change/learning verb is in the key 8/10 where it varies (regex).

patterns.property: 'X and why Y' double-question option is never the key
patterns.evidence: 0/5 (authors B, C, F). 'What the coach taught and why the writer quit the team', 'How Derwin was injured and why local runners praised his idea', 'how Fintan sold spices alone and why the old man refused to pay him', 'How Minna set up the tablet and why Osric could not hear his grandfather'. The broader how/why...and how/why two-clause shape is mixed (3/11).

patterns.property: main-idea option carrying a number/time detail is never the key
patterns.evidence: 0/4: 'one summer', 'the first version of the map', 'shortly before the first night', 'for twenty years'. Weak: this is the expected narrow-detail distractor and n=4.

patterns.property: vocabulary odd-one-out: three distractors share one sense family, key outside it
patterns.evidence: Hand-coded 3/3, no counter-example among the 30 vocab sets: 'declined' = grew weaker / sloped downward / slowly decreased / *politely refused; 'studying' = learning for a test / reading for a course / researching in a lab / *looking at closely; 'flexible' = *bendable / adaptable / easygoing / negotiable. Only three sets have a 3-member family, so n is minimal.
